name: Kneeling Single-Arm Cable Chest Press
description: The Kneeling Single-Arm Cable Press is performed in a half-kneeling or tall-kneeling position, pressing one cable handle forward while the kneeling stance eliminates leg drive and demands significant hip flexor and core stability. The unilateral load creates anti-rotation demands on the torso, making this a functional press variation that builds pressing strength alongside core and hip stability.

execution.starting_position: Set a cable pulley to chest height. Kneel facing away from the machine (tall kneeling) or in a half-kneeling stance (one knee down, one foot forward). Hold one handle at chest level on the same side as the working arm.
execution.setup_instructions: Set cable to mid-chest height. Kneel on a mat for comfort. In a half-kneeling stance, the kneeling leg is on the same side as the cable for optimal stability.
steps: Step 1: Hold the cable handle at chest level, brace the core.
Step 2: Press forward until the arm is fully extended.
Step 3: Return under control to the starting position.
Step 4: Complete all reps on one side, then switch.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the press. Inhale on return.
common_mistakes: Rotating the torso toward the pressing arm
Leaning excessively forward or backward during the press
safety_considerations: Start light until the stabilization pattern is established
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full arm extension; return to chest-level start.
coaching_cues: Hips stay neutral — don't let them shift
Squeeze the chest and think about pressing through the target, not just extending the arm
